scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an R&B stadium concert, [X] compares lower-garment categories across steep stairs, hard seats, sustained dancing, crowd contact, indoor heat, a colder exit, loaded pockets, and repeated access to a concealed phone belt.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在参加一场 R&B 体育场演唱会前，[X]会比较不同下装类别能否应对陡峭台阶、硬座、长时间跳舞、人群接触、场内热气、散场后的降温、装满物品的口袋，以及反复取用隐藏手机腰包。
examples: using Regular Fit when sitting, stairs, and pocket access need a stable middle ground
using Loose Fit or Athletic Fit when dancing needs room without letting loaded pockets swing or sag
using Slim Fit, Skinny Fit, or Compression Fit only when closeness or support does not bind, overheat, roll, or block the concealed phone belt

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cloudy, slightly cold day, [X] builds an outfit around an existing thin black bomber and compares lower silhouettes through comfort, visual proportion, warmth, and whether the layers still look deliberate.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一个多云且略冷的日子里，[X]会以已有的轻薄黑色飞行夹克为核心，从舒适度、视觉比例、保暖性以及叠穿是否仍显得有意设计等方面比较不同下装版型。
examples: using Regular Fit when the bomber, sweatshirt, and bottom need balanced proportions
using Slim Fit or Skinny Fit when a close lower line should offset the jacket without becoming restrictive
using Loose Fit or Athletic Fit when comfort matters more, while checking that the jacket and longer inner layer do not make the silhouette look accidental

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While establishing a potty routine for a child who cannot yet speak, [X] repeatedly observes whether the child can lower and raise familiar trousers quickly and independently when a timer or nonverbal cue signals urgency.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为尚不会说话的幼儿建立如厕规律时，[X]会反复观察：当计时器或非语言信号提示紧迫需求时，孩子能否迅速且独立地拉下、再提起熟悉的下装。
examples: using Loose Fit when independent pull-down and pull-up speed is the main constraint
using Regular Fit when the garment should stay secure during play but remain manageable at the potty
rejecting Slim Fit, Skinny Fit, or Compression Fit when closeness repeatedly requires adult help during an urgent transition

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor golf luncheon for twenty-five women, [X] translates one playful dress theme into skirts, skorts, shorts, jeans, and coordinated sets that remain comfortable between tables and coherent in mixed-age group photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位女性组织户外高尔夫午宴时，[X]会把同一个趣味着装主题转化为裙装、裙裤、短裤、牛仔裤和成套穿搭，并要求这些下装在桌间活动时保持舒适、在不同年龄参与者的集体合影中保持协调。
examples: using Regular Fit or Slim Fit when a polished country-club interpretation still needs sitting comfort
using Loose Fit when the lounge-inspired interpretation should remain deliberate rather than shapeless
using Athletic Fit or Skinny Fit only where the skort, shorts, or jeans still suit the wearer's movement and the shared visual theme

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During recovery from tailbone pain, [X] changes lower-garment categories for supported desk sitting, short walking breaks, and repeated sit-to-stand transitions, treating pressure at the waist, seat, rear seams, and thighs as evidence rather than choosing by appearance alone.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在尾骨疼痛恢复期间，[X]会为有支撑的桌前久坐、短暂步行休息和反复坐站转换更换不同下装类别，并把腰部、臀部、后部接缝和大腿处的压力作为判断依据，而不只看外观。
examples: using Loose Fit when reducing rear pressure and seam contact is the immediate priority
using Regular Fit when extra room must not cause shifting during walking or standing
rejecting Slim Fit, Skinny Fit, or Compression Fit when close pressure recreates the pain associated with tight jeans or thick rear seams

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After sharing two previously worn outfits, [X] compares the visible lower silhouette with straight, fitted, and roomier alternatives to identify proportions that suit the body shown in the photographs rather than following a universal slimming rule.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 分享两张实际穿过的搭配照片后，[X]会把照片中可见的下半身轮廓与直筒、贴身和更宽松的替代方案比较，以判断哪些比例更适合照片呈现的身体条件，而不是机械遵循统一的显瘦规则。
examples: using Regular Fit when the photographed outfit needs a neutral lower balance
comparing Slim Fit or Skinny Fit with the actual outfit when a closer line may lengthen the silhouette without overemphasizing the hips
using Loose Fit or Athletic Fit only when added room does not create the lower-body bulk the user is trying to avoid

scenarios.scenario_abstract: In a student fashion discussion, [X] challenges the assumption that one close jean silhouette flatters everyone and compares lower fits across athletic and curvier bodies, long class days, ordinary movement, affordability, and body-positive representation.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一次学生穿搭讨论中，[X]会质疑“同一种贴身牛仔版型适合所有人”的假设，并结合运动型与曲线型身材、长时间上课、日常活动、价格负担和身体积极呈现来比较不同下装版型。
examples: using Regular Fit as a baseline before judging polish or room on a comparable body
comparing Slim Fit and Skinny Fit through sitting and walking rather than trend status alone
using Loose Fit or Athletic Fit when the wearer's build and daily movement need room without erasing shape

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping for casual clothes, [X] uploads a white T-shirt, asks about straight, slim, and loose jeans, then shares a pictured slim-fit pair under consideration and checks whether that exact candidate preserves both comfort and the desired clean outfit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在购买休闲服装时，[X]会上传一件白色 T 恤，询问直筒、修身和宽松牛仔裤的区别，随后又分享一条正在考虑的修身牛仔裤图片，并确认这件具体候选是否同时保留舒适度和想要的简洁搭配。
examples: keeping Slim Fit when the pictured pair looks polished with the white T-shirt without feeling overfitted
switching to Regular Fit when the same clean combination needs a more neutral balance
switching to Loose Fit or rejecting a Skinny Fit alternative when casual comfort matters more than the closest line

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a five-day Dubai trip, [X] plans lower-garment categories that can cover intense outdoor heat, cold air-conditioned interiors, modest public spaces, hotel and pool transitions, smart-casual venues, and long periods of walking or driving.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为期五天的迪拜旅行中，[X]规划的下装类别需要同时应对户外酷热、室内强空调、要求端庄的公共空间、酒店与泳池之间的转换、商务休闲场所，以及长时间步行或驾车。
examples: using Loose Fit when airflow and modest coverage must coexist in outdoor heat
using Regular Fit when one bottom must move between public sightseeing and smart-casual venues
using Slim Fit or Skinny Fit only when close structure remains comfortable after walking, driving, and moving between heat and air conditioning

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While strictly limiting pack weight, [X] assigns each lower layer to repeated 20-to-30-kilometer stages, steep climbs, icy descents, shared lodging, washing, and rapid weather changes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在严格限制背包重量的同时，[X]会让每一层下装承担每日 20 至 30 公里的重复行走、陡坡、结冰下坡、共享住宿、洗涤和快速天气变化。
examples: using Athletic Fit when long strides, hills, and repeated days need movement-specific room
using Compression Fit only when deliberate support remains tolerable over consecutive long stages and under winter layers
using Regular Fit or Loose Fit when ventilation, layering, shared-lodging changes, and simple washing matter more than close support

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A founder planning the first week of Instagram content for a medical-scrubs brand builds short demonstrations around scrub bottoms during commuting, clinical movement, pocket use, and a long student day so fit benefits are shown rather than merely claimed.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名医疗手术服品牌创办者在规划首周 Instagram 内容时，围绕通勤、临床活动、口袋使用和医学生长时间学习日中的手术裤设计短演示，让版型优势通过过程呈现，而不只是口头宣称。
